systemOverview.executiveSummary: A TypeScript slug module and a one-page preview server built on node:http, with no runtime dependencies.
systemOverview.systemPurpose: Turn titles into slugs and preview them in a browser.
systemOverview.architecturalApproach: Pure exported functions in an ESM TypeScript module; a node:http server renders the preview page from them; vitest runs the in-process specs and @playwright/test drives the page.
